info.title: EV Car News API
info.description:
REST API of EV Car News (evcar.news). Conventions:
- Prefix /api/v1; admin routes under /api/v1/admin (permission-guarded), personal routes under /api/v1/me.
- Language: ?lang=ar|en overrides Accept-Language (default ar). Market: ?market=EG overrides X-Market.
- Single resource: {"data": {...}}; lists: {"data": [...], "meta": {page, pageSize, total, totalPages}}.
- Errors: {"error": {"code", "message" (localized), "details"?, "requestId"}}; validation → 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.
- Money: {"amount": "decimal string", "currency": "EGP"}; missing values are null (never 0).

message.example: بعض الحقول غير صالحة. راجع التفاصيل.

details.description: Code-specific details (e.g. field errors for VALIDATION_FAILED).

password.description: At least 8 characters; common passwords and passwords containing the email/name are rejected (422 on field "password").

token.description: Token from the verification e-mail link.

refreshToken.description: Rotating refresh token (mobile). Omitted for web clients (X-Client-Type: web), which get the httpOnly cookie evcar_rt instead.
Mobile clients send the refresh token here. Web clients (X-Client-Type: web) omit it; the httpOnly cookie evcar_rt is used.
Mobile clients send the refresh token here. Web clients (X-Client-Type: web) omit it; the httpOnly cookie evcar_rt is used.

token.description: Token from the reset e-mail or the create-owner setup link.

idToken.description: Google ID token (JWT) obtained by the client SDK.

identityToken.description: Apple identity token (JWT) obtained by Sign in with Apple.

current.description: True for the session of the calling access token.

roles.description: Complete role set; "user" is always kept.

permissions.description: Effective permission keys (the owner role always has all of them).

permissionsEditable.description: False for the owner role (always every permission).

configured.description: false → the app must not show a map (no tiles or no attribution).

features.description: Effective feature flags (tripPlanner/assistant are false while their service is not configured).

value.description: Typed value of the key (see the PUT body of each key).

isDefault.description: true when no admin value is stored (built-in default).

warnings.description: Admin hints, e.g. licence/usage policy notes.

logoUrl.description: Absolute URL of the logo (use POST /admin/settings/branding/logo to upload one).

file.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 1 MB.

sections.description: Each key at most once; orders unique.

tripPlanner.description: Effective only while a routing provider is configured.

assistant.description: Effective only while an assistant LLM is configured.

tileUrlTemplate.description: Must contain {z}, {x} and {y}; {s} for subdomains; {r} for retina is allowed.

attribution.description: Required whenever tiles are configured (licence attribution).

defaultImageUrl.description: Default OG image for shared links.

androidSha256CertFingerprints.description: SHA-256 signing certificate fingerprints (upper-case hex pairs).

defaultLanguage.description: Suggested language only — language and market are independent.

enabled.description: New markets start disabled until their data is ready.
New markets start disabled until their data is ready.

namespaces.description: { namespace: { key: text } } — overrides to layer over bundled strings.

value.description: Plain text (clients must render it as text, never HTML).

namespace.description: Feature namespace (admin/mobile UI) or a server namespace: errors, notifications, labels.

type.description: storage | mail | stations | availability | routing | geocoding | news | push | oauth | assistant

enabled.description: false when configured but inactive (e.g. console mail in production).

checkable.description: A live check can be run with POST .../integrations/{id}/check.

reason.description: Why it is not configured (names missing variables, never values).

note.description: Statuses are per API instance (last success/error are kept in memory).

demoRows.description: Rows flagged is_demo (must be 0 in production).

stationsNotRecentlyVerified.description: Published stations never verified or verified before the threshold.

pricesOutdated.description: Current prices (no end date) older than the threshold.

rssFeedsFailing.description: Active RSS feeds failing or not fetched successfully recently.

mediaStuck.description: Media stuck in uploading/processing for over an hour.

failedJobs.description: Failed BullMQ jobs over all queues.

warnings.description: Things an admin should look at.

workersEnabledHere.description: Whether this API instance runs workers (JOBS_ENABLED).

progress.description: Number 0..100 or an object set by the processor.
Number 0..100 or an object set by the processor.

dataKeys.description: Top-level keys of the job data (values hidden).

latencyMs.description: Round-trip latency in ms when up.

storage.description: Media storage (local disk write/read probe, or S3 HeadBucket).

status.description: ok = all up; degraded = Redis or storage down (API still serves; jobs/uploads affected); error = database down (HTTP 503).
